reviewer: Agent-assisted source and taxonomy desk review; not expert, legal, or field certification
purpose: Project three CC0 Smithsonian preserved-fish specimen records as historical text-locality evidence for the Species page. Preserve the shared locality verbatim; do not project a coordinate or treat the records as current presence.

source.provider: National Museum of Natural History, Smithsonian Institution via GBIF
source.citation: Orrell T, Informatics and Data Science Center - Digital Stewardship (2026). NMNH Extant Specimen Records (USNM, US). Version 1.113. National Museum of Natural History, Smithsonian Institution. Occurrence dataset https://doi.org/10.15468/hnhrg3 accessed via GBIF.org on 2026-10-24.
source.reviewScope: Only the three selected occurrence rows and factual fields listed in this review; no photographs, media, coordinates, or unrelated records.

occurrenceQuery.interpretation: This bounded administrative screen located records with explicit Malolos, Bulacan fish-trap locality text. It is not a Bulacan checklist. Nine results were not projected: one genus-level record and eight records without a comparably resolved fish-trap locality or with other record-level limitations.

sharedLocality.verbatim: Taken from a fish trap, Malolos, Bulacan, Philippines (northern shore of Manila Bay).
sharedLocality.normalizedDisplay: Malolos, Bulacan · northern shore of Manila Bay
sharedLocality.waterBodyDecision: Do not project the broad GBIF waterBody value; the source locality provides a more specific shoreline context, but does not establish a precise fishing station or a named river, creek, or estuary.
sharedLocality.coordinateDecision: No coordinates are present in the selected GBIF records. No map point or geometry is added.

decision.reason: Three dated, species-rank preserved specimens share explicit Malolos/Bulacan fish-trap locality text, stable museum catalog numbers, record-level and dataset CC0 declarations, and current valid-name checks in ITIS. Projection is limited to the source's historical text assertion and retained quality flags.
caveats: The collection month is February 1982; this is historical evidence, not current presence or a complete Manila Bay, Malolos, or Bulacan fish list.
The source locality names the northern shore of Manila Bay and a fish trap but not an exact station, river, creek, estuary, boundary, or coordinates.
The broad GBIF waterBody value 'Pacific' is not projected because the more specific locality text does not support assigning the specimens to that named waterbody value.
GBIF infers occurrenceStatus PRESENT from individualCount; the three specimen-row counts are not abundance estimates or a population measure.
ITIS validates the names' taxonomic standing only; it does not independently re-identify these museum specimens or verify the locality.
One additional same-locality result was genus-level Apocryptodon and is excluded from species assertions. Other query results lacked adequate locality or had separate limitations.
No current presence, abundance, catchability, legality, food safety, diet, bait effectiveness, or fishing-access claim is made.
